verses.text: O my soul, bless YHWH! O YHWH my God, You are very great; with honor and majesty You are clothed.

segments.text: O my soul, bless YHWH! O YHWH my God, You are very great; with honor and majesty You are clothed.

verses.text: Covering Himself [with] light as a garment, stretching out the heavens like a curtain,

segments.text: Covering Himself [with] light as a garment, stretching out the heavens like a curtain,

verses.text: the One laying the beams in the waters of His upper chambers, the One making the clouds His chariot, the One walking on the wings of the wind,

segments.text: the One laying the beams in the waters of His upper chambers, the One making the clouds His chariot, the One walking on the wings of the wind,

verses.text: making the winds His messengers, His servants flaming fire.

segments.text: making the winds His messengers, His servants flaming fire.

verses.text: He set the earth upon [its] foundations; it should not be shaken forever and ever.

segments.text: He set the earth upon [its] foundations; it should not be shaken forever and ever.

verses.text: The deep, as [with] a garment You covered it; upon the mountains the waters were standing.

segments.text: The deep, as [with] a garment You covered it; upon the mountains the waters were standing.

verses.text: From Your rebuke they fled; from the voice of Your thunder they hurried away.

segments.text: From Your rebuke they fled; from the voice of Your thunder they hurried away.

verses.text: Upon the mountains, the valleys sank down, to the place that You established for them.

segments.text: Upon the mountains, the valleys sank down, to the place that You established for them.

verses.text: You have set a boundary [that] they may not cross over; they may never return to cover the earth.

segments.text: You have set a boundary [that] they may not cross over; they may never return to cover the earth.

verses.text: He sends the springs into the valleys; they flow between the hills.

segments.text: He sends the springs into the valleys; they flow between the hills.

verses.text: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys break their thirst.

segments.text: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys break their thirst.

verses.text: Nearby them the birds of the heavens are dwelling; from between the branches they give forth a voice.

segments.text: Nearby them the birds of the heavens are dwelling; from between the branches they give forth a voice.

verses.text: Watering the hills from His upper chambers; with the fruit of Your works the earth is satisfied—

segments.text: Watering the hills from His upper chambers; with the fruit of Your works the earth is satisfied—

verses.text: causing the grass to sprout for the cattle, and vegetation for the service of man, to bring forth food from the earth,

segments.text: causing the grass to sprout for the cattle, and vegetation for the service of man, to bring forth food from the earth,

verses.text: and wine makes glad the heart of man, to make [his] face shine from oil, and bread supports the heart of man.

segments.text: and wine makes glad the heart of man, to make [his] face shine from oil, and bread supports the heart of man.

verses.text: The trees of YHWH are satisfied, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,

segments.text: The trees of YHWH are satisfied, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,

verses.text: where in the birds make their nests; the stork—the cypresses [are] her house.

segments.text: where in the birds make their nests; the stork—the cypresses [are] her house.

verses.text: The high mountains [are] for the wild goats; the crags a refuge for the rock badgers.

segments.text: The high mountains [are] for the wild goats; the crags a refuge for the rock badgers.

verses.text: He made the moon for appointed times; the sun knows its entrance.

segments.text: He made the moon for appointed times; the sun knows its entrance.

verses.text: You make darkness, and it becomes night; in it all the living [things] of the forest crawl.

segments.text: You make darkness, and it becomes night; in it all the living [things] of the forest crawl.

verses.text: The young lions roar for the prey and seek their food from God.

segments.text: The young lions roar for the prey and seek their food from God.

verses.text: The sun rises, they are gathered; and in their dens they stretch out.

segments.text: The sun rises, they are gathered; and in their dens they stretch out.

verses.text: Man goes out to his work, and to his labor until the evening.

segments.text: Man goes out to his work, and to his labor until the evening.

verses.text: How many are Your works, O YHWH! All of them You have made in wisdom; the earth is full of Your creatures.

segments.text: How many are Your works, O YHWH! All of them You have made in wisdom; the earth is full of Your creatures.

verses.text: This [is] the sea, great and wide—in it [are] crawling things, and without number, living things small with the great.

segments.text: This [is] the sea, great and wide—in it [are] crawling things, and without number, living things small with the great.

verses.text: There the ships go about, [and] Leviathan, which You formed to play in it.

segments.text: There the ships go about, [and] Leviathan, which You formed to play in it.

verses.text: All of them look to You, to give their food, in its season.

segments.text: All of them look to You, to give their food, in its season.

verses.text: You give to them, [and] they gather in; You open Your hand, [and] they are satisfied [with] good.

segments.text: You give to them, [and] they gather in; You open Your hand, [and] they are satisfied [with] good.

verses.text: You hide Your face—they are troubled; You gather their spirit—they die, and to their dust they return.

segments.text: You hide Your face—they are troubled; You gather their spirit—they die, and to their dust they return.

verses.text: You send forth Your Spirit—they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.

segments.text: You send forth Your Spirit—they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.

verses.text: May the glory of YHWH be forever; may YHWH rejoice in His works—

segments.text: May the glory of YHWH be forever; may YHWH rejoice in His works—

verses.text: the One looking on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

segments.text: the One looking on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

verses.text: I will sing to YHWH during my life; I will sing praise to my God while I [live]!

segments.text: I will sing to YHWH during my life; I will sing praise to my God while I [live]!

verses.text: May my melody be pleasing to Him; I rejoice in YHWH.

segments.text: May my melody be pleasing to Him; I rejoice in YHWH.

verses.text: May the sinful ones be consumed from the earth, and the wicked shall not be anymore! O my soul, bless YHWH! Hallelu YAH!
